beforeToken = () => {
  html`<div style="color:#b3b3b3; padding: 1rem;">
    Introduz o teu Spotify access token para carregar os dados.
  </div>`
}
fetchWebApi = async (endpoint, method, body) => {
    if(!token) 
      // Se não existir um token, não chama a API
      return null;
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.spotify.com/${endpoint}`, {
        headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        },
        method,
        body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined
    });

    // Se o token estiver inválido devolve null
    if(!res.ok) return null;
     
    return await res.json();
}

getUserProfile = async () => {

  if(!token) return null;

  return await fetchWebApi(`v1/me`, "GET");
}

getDisplayUserProfile = async (id) => {

  if(!token || id === null) return null;

  return await fetchWebApi(`v1/users/${id}`, "GET");
}

auxProfile = await getUserProfile();

userProfile = await getDisplayUserProfile(auxProfile.id)

getTopTracks = async () => {
  
  if(!token) return [];

  return (await fetchWebApi(
    'v1/me/top/tracks?time_range=long_term&limit=50', 'GET'
  )).items;
}

formatDuration = (ms) => {
    const minutes = Math.floor(ms / 60000);
    const seconds = ((ms % 60000) / 1000).toFixed(0);
    return `${minutes}:${seconds < 10 ? '0' : ''}${seconds}`;
}

// Renderização da lista
{

                <img class="track-img" src="${track.album.images[2]?.url}">
                <div class="track-info">
                    <div class="track-name">${track.name}</div>
                    <div class="track-artist">${track.artists.map(a => a.name).join(', ')}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="track-duration">${formatDuration(track.duration_ms)}</div>
            </div>`;
        
        row.onclick = () => {
            mutable selectedTrack = track;
        };
        
        return row;
        })}
        </div>`;

    return container;
}
localAudioFiles = await fetch("assets/data/localTopTracks.json")
  .then(response => response.json())
  .catch(() => [])

mutable selectedLocalTrack = null
mutable audioSource = null

mutable isPlaying = false
mutable currentTrackIndex = 0

mutable currentVolume = 50

function updatePlayingState() {
  if (window.__currentAudioProcessor) {
    mutable isPlaying = window.__currentAudioProcessor.getIsPlaying();
  }
}
playPause = async () => {
  if (!window.__currentAudioProcessor) return;
  
  await window.__currentAudioProcessor.resumeAudio();
  updatePlayingState();
}

// Track anterior
previousTrack = async () => {
  if (localAudioFiles.length === 0) return;
  
  const newIndex = currentTrackIndex > 0 
    ? currentTrackIndex - 1 
    : localAudioFiles.length - 1;
  
  mutable currentTrackIndex = newIndex;
  mutable selectedLocalTrack = localAudioFiles[newIndex];
  mutable audioSource = localAudioFiles[newIndex];
}

// Próxima track
nextTrack = async () => {
  if (localAudioFiles.length === 0) return;
  
  const newIndex = (currentTrackIndex + 1) % localAudioFiles.length;
  
  mutable currentTrackIndex = newIndex;
  mutable selectedLocalTrack = localAudioFiles[newIndex];
  mutable audioSource = localAudioFiles[newIndex];
  
}
{
  const container = html`<div class="track-list-container local-tracks">${localAudioFiles.map((track, index) => {
    const row = html`
      <div class="track-item ${track === selectedLocalTrack ? 'active' : ''}">
        <img class="track-img" src="${track.img}">
        <div class="track-info">
          <div class="track-name">${track.name}</div>
          <div class="track-artist">${track.artist}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="track-duration">${track.duration}</div>
      </div>`;
    
    row.onclick = () => {
      mutable currentTrackIndex = index;
      mutable selectedLocalTrack = track;
      mutable audioSource = track;
    };
    
    return row;
  })}</div>`;
  return container;
}

{
  const handleKeyPress = (e) => {
    if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') return;
    
    if (e.code === 'Space') {
      e.preventDefault();
      playPause();
    } else if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') {
      e.preventDefault();
      previousTrack();
    } else if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') {
      e.preventDefault();
      nextTrack();
    }
  };
  
  document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyPress);
  return "Atalhos de teclado ativados";
}

async function loadSourceAsFile(source) {
  
  if (source instanceof File) {
    return source;
  }

  if (source?.path) {
    const response = await fetch(source.path);
    const blob = await response.blob();

    return new File(
      [blob],
      source.name ?? "audio.mp3",
      { type: blob.type || "audio/mpeg" }
    );
  }

  throw new Error("Fonte de áudio inválida");
}
{
  if (!audioSource || !window.AudioProcessor) {
    return html`<div style="color:#b3b3b3;">Aguarda carregamento...</div>`;
  }

  if (window.__currentAudioProcessor) {
    try {
      window.__currentAudioProcessor.stop?.();
      window.__currentAudioProcessor.audioContext?.close?.();
    } catch (e) {}
    window.__currentAudioProcessor = null;
  }
  
  const file = await loadSourceAsFile(audioSource);
  
  const audioProcessor = new window.AudioProcessor();

  await audioProcessor.loadAudioFile(file);

  window.__currentAudioProcessor = audioProcessor;
  
  // Atualizar estado
  mutable isPlaying = true;
  
  const visualizer = new window.VisualizationEngine("canva", audioProcessor);
  
  visualizer.setVisualization("waveform");
}
